_about: The layout of the GTA 6 HQ Discord server. scripts/discord_setup.py reads this and creates, renames, moves and reorders to match; it never deletes anything. Channels and categories are matched ignoring their emoji prefix, so changing an emoji renames the channel. Edit this file and run the script again to change the server. A role's emoji is shown in front of its name on the server; everywhere in this file roles are named without it. The server is chosen by guild_id, never by name.

welcome: # Welcome to Grand Theft Auto VI HQ
This is the community for **GTA 6 HQ**, an unofficial fan encyclopedia and field manual for Grand Theft Auto VI.
**This server and the app are fan-made.** They are not run, approved or endorsed by Rockstar Games or Take-Two Interactive.

**Where to go**
- Read the rules in <#rules>
- New versions of the app appear in <#releases>
- Talk about the game in <#general>
- Found a wrong fact? Post it with a source in <#corrections>
rules: **1. Be decent.** No harassment, hate, slurs or personal attacks.
**2. No leaks.** Do not post or link leaked or stolen material: builds, source code, unreleased footage or documents. Official trailers, screenshots and interviews are fine.
**3. No spoilers outside the spoiler channels.** Story details go in the spoiler channels, and behind spoiler tags in images.
**4. No piracy, cheats or account selling.** That includes modded accounts, money drops and cracked copies.
**5. Say where facts come from.** In <#corrections> and <#news-and-trailers>, link your source. Label guesses as guesses.
**6. No spam or self-promotion** without a moderator's say-so.
**7. Keep it legal and within Discord's rules.** https://discord.com/guidelines
Moderators may remove posts or members to keep the server usable. Questions about a decision go to a moderator in private, not in public channels.
